title: Custom Endpoint
description: Connect any OpenAI-compatible server or a model endpoint on your network.

empty.title: Your own models, wherever they run

dialog.description: Enter a name and the server’s base URL.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.nameLocked: The name identifies the endpoint and cannot be changed.
dialog.invalidUrl: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL.
dialog.ownServer: This is Atomic Chat's own Local API Server ({{url}}). A custom endpoint must be another server: requests to this address would only come back to the app.
dialog.localModelCollision: “{{model}}” is also a local model. The Local API Server sends requests for it to {{provider}}, the provider selected for it on the server page.
dialog.localModelCollisionEndpoint: “{{model}}” is also a local model. The Local API Server sends requests for it to this endpoint, the provider selected for it on the server page.
dialog.localModelCollisionUnselected: “{{model}}” is also a local model. Until a provider is selected for it on the server page, the Local API Server sends requests for it to this endpoint.
dialog.keyRejected: {{name}} refused the request. Check the API key.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.description: This removes the endpoint, its models and its configuration.

dstar.title: Dstar local server
dstar.reloadHint: Changing the model or context requires reloading the server.
dstar.restartConfirm: Stop the current server and reload with these settings? Active requests will be interrupted.
dstar.lifecycle: Closing the window keeps Dstar running. Quitting Atomic stops only the Dstar server it started.
dstar.externalHint: This server was started outside Atomic. Stop it there before handing control to Atomic.

status.error: Could not keep the server running

reason.invalidContext: Enter a context size from 512 to 524288 tokens
reason.alreadyRunning: Stop the current model before starting another
reason.portInUse: Port 8010 is already in use; no other process was stopped
reason.notOwned: Atomic did not start this server and will not stop it
reason.stopTimeout: The server has not stopped yet. Wait before starting another model.
reason.unsupportedPlatform: Dstar is supported on Apple Silicon macOS only

localEngine.title: Local engine
localEngine.waiting: Engine change will apply after the current reply and tools finish.
localEngine.strataCaution: Strata IQ3_XXS is an experimental engine with high memory requirements. Available features depend on the server’s reported capabilities. The separate 16K summary state is experimental. Low memory can defer summarization. Stability has not yet been verified on this Mac.
localEngine.selectDstar: Choose Dstar in the chat model selector before using these controls.

errors.engineSummaryRecoveryRequired: The previous summary failed to restore model state. Stop this engine, then start it again.
errors.engineBusy: Another reply or tool is still running. Finish or stop it, then try again.
errors.foreignEngine: A server is running outside Atomic. Stop it in the app that started it, then try again.
errors.engineTransition: The previous engine is still stopping. Wait, then try again.
errors.stopFailed: The previous engine did not stop. The other engine was not started.
errors.modelNotServed: The selected model is not available on this engine. Choose an available model.
errors.engineTimeout: Loading timed out. Check the runtime and model files, then try again.
errors.engineSelectionChanged: The selected model changed while starting. Send again with the current selection.
errors.engineFailed: The engine could not start. Check the runtime and model files, then try again.
errors.otherLocalEngine: Unload the current local model before starting this engine.
errors.managedEngineRunning: Stop Dstar or Strata in the chat model selector before loading another local model.
errors.invalidStrataContext: Enter a whole number from 16384 to 65536 tokens.
errors.strataSettingsWriteFailed: The context setting could not be saved. Check available disk space and try again.
errors.strataContextPinMismatch: The Strata runtime has changed. Context changes are blocked until this runtime is verified.
errors.strataContextPinCalculationFailed: The Strata runtime configuration could not be verified. Try again after the current work finishes.
errors.processInspectionFailed: The local server’s process ownership could not be verified temporarily. Checking its status again.

localEngine.pendingContext: Pending: {{context}} tokens. Apply by starting or restarting Strata.
localEngine.strataContextHint: 16,384–65,536 tokens. Larger contexts use more memory. The experimental summary state remains 16K.
